profile.headline: Front End Developer | Expert in Responsive Web Development | HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP
profile.summary:
I am a skilled Front End Developer with over 12 years of experience in responsive web development. Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, user interface design, testing, and debugging.

At FindLaw, part of Thomson Reuters, I developed hundreds of responsive websites, improved page speed scores, and ensured ADA compliance. I also collaborated with graphic designers and high-profile clients to deliver top-notch solutions.

I am passionate about staying updated with the latest web development trends and continuously enhancing my skills to deliver exceptional results.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Developed hundreds of responsive websites optimized for both desktop and mobile using HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.
- Collaborated closely with graphic designers to ensure websites accurately matched Photoshop designs.
- Assisted in migrating numerous websites from a proprietary platform to WordPress.
- Partnered with high-spending clients to provide efficient troubleshooting and solutions for their websites.
- Worked alongside the development team in Bangalore, India, to implement best practices.
- Contributed to improving page speed scores across hundreds of websites, focusing on LCP, CLS, and INP metrics.
- Collaborated with third-party vendor Modern Tribe on a drag-and-drop WordPress theme builder.
- Ensured websites were accessible and compliant with ADA standards.

positions.title: Front End Developer & Web Designer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed websites for sports teams.
- Created logos for multiple sports teams.
- Vectorized hundreds of logos for sports teams needing a vector file format.
- Collaborated closely with other designers and developers on large, complex websites.
- Identified, diagnosed, and resolved website issues, including broken links, typographical errors, and formatting problems.
- Stayed up-to-date with new standards, technologies, and trends in website development.
